Name: Honor Beyond Death
Description: When this Regiment is activated by a [Ka] Ideal card remove the Broken status from this Regiment.

Name: Wrathful Momentum
Description: The Regiment may Re-Roll failed Hit Rolls of “6” and gain the Terrifying (1) Special Rule against Size 1 Regiments.

Name: Powerful Presence
Description: This [Character] Stand counts as 3 Stands for the purposes of Seizing Objective Zones when attached to a non-Light Regiment.

Name: Lord of Roaring Flames
Description:
[Always Active]: Once per Round, when Activating a Regiment or [Character] with the same Ideal Card as your Warlord, you may also gain the following effects: "The Regiment gains the Glorious Charge Special Rule until the end of the Round.
[Activated]: During this Round all Friendly Regiments Activated with the same Ideal Card as your Warlord benefit from its effects regardless of their Battlefield Role.

Name: Command Special Rules Oni Ayakashi
Description: The Regiment adds +1 to its Attacks Characteristic and gains the Juggernaut Special Rule.
